periods.time: vol-15 ch-003, start of the Vermillion-Quedland war

name.zh: 代表战开幕与战场分裂
name.en: Representative war opening and battlefield split

periods.location: Luxel city gate, castle, sky and residential districts
periods.summary: The televised five-on-five war begins, but Naseem's immediate charge scatters the Vermillion team and turns the mixed battle into several personal duels.
periods.cause: The League-sanctioned war between Vermillion and Quedland starts under broadcast rules, with Vermillion fielding Stella, Nene, Alice, Ikki and Yui against Or-Gaule's faction and puppets.
periods.process: The announcer introduces both sides and emphasizes the danger of the war. At the start signal, Naseem rockets from the castle roof to the city gate and unleashes Mictlan Tormenta, destroying the gate and blasting four Vermillion representatives into the air. Nene alone remains by using gravity and immediately engages Naseem. Stella tries to rescue falling Ikki, but John intercepts her in the sky on Golden Chariot. Ikki must solve his fall and is attacked by B.B. Alice lands in a residential area and is drawn into Or-Gaule's Bloody Cross reenactment. Yui tracks Ein to the castle rose garden.
periods.outcome: Instead of exploiting team tactics, Quedland's side embraces one-on-one vendettas: Nene vs Naseem, Stella vs John, Ikki vs B.B., Alice vs Or-Gaule, and Yui vs Ein.
periods.aftermath: Ikki and Stella quickly win their first duels, while Yui and Alice enter more prolonged, dangerous battles.
casualties: Luxel gate and nearby buildings destroyed
periods.significance: Defines the first phase of the volume's war structure and isolates each representative into a thematically matched opponent.
